verdict.rationale: Azure docs explicitly cover exporting existing resources to Terraform HCL and generating Terraform configs via Azure Copilot, which supports a brownfield/import workflow rather than greenfield-only IaC. However, there's no documented drift-detection workflow, and no equivalent import tooling is evidenced for Bicep/ARM templates. Missing for 10: explicit drift-detection/reconciliation docs, ARM/Bicep import workflow evidence, independent hands-on confirmation of the export-to-HCL flow.
